interactionHelp: Hover to get a reaction. Click to invite. Drag to play. Click elsewhere to return home.
introductionHoverBody: Move your pointer over Mallow for a small reaction.
introductionInviteBody: Click Mallow to invite it out. Click again for a wave or a swing.
introductionDragBody: Drag Mallow to pick it up. Release away from home for a squishy landing.
introductionCatchBody: Hold Mallow near home. When it looks up, release to let it catch. Choose its home display and location in Settings.
introductionHomeBody: Click elsewhere to send Mallow home. Replay these demos from Help → Meet Mallow.
introductionReducedMotion: Reduce Motion is on. Each demo shows a still moment.
settingsNote: Size, movement and home are saved on this Mac. Show and Animate apply for this session. Reduce Motion takes priority. Launch at login is managed by macOS.
menuControlsHelp: The leaf in the menu bar opens Settings or quits Spriglet. In Settings, use Show Mallow, Animate Mallow or Bring Home to recover Mallow, and choose Launch at Login. Meet Mallow and Help are available from Spriglet’s native Help menu and offline Help panel.
recoveryHelp: Hidden Mallow stays hidden through sleep, lock and display changes. Open Settings from the leaf in the menu bar and choose Show Mallow or Bring Home, or reopen Spriglet from Finder. Bring Home and Finder recovery return it to its resting home and preserve Pause.
localHelp: Everything stays on your Mac. Settings opens with keyboard focus; Help preserves focus in your current app. For support, email {{supportEmail}}.
loginRequiresApproval: Off · Approval required in System Settings
loginNotFound: Unavailable · macOS could not find this app
loginApprovalHelp: Allow Spriglet in System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions. It will not launch at login until macOS reports it as enabled. To cancel registration, turn off Launch at Login in Settings.
accessibleCharacterHelp: Press to invite or react. Use actions to invite with a wave, swing, stretch, bring home, pause or resume, hide, open Settings, meet Mallow or get help. Bring Home needs no dragging. The leaf in the menu bar opens Settings or quits Spriglet; recover hidden Mallow in Settings.
keyboardHelp: Use Control-F8 (or Fn-Control-F8) to reach the leaf in the menu bar, then arrow keys and Return to choose Settings or Quit. In Settings, use Tab and Shift-Tab, arrows for choices and Space for buttons, including Show, Animate and Bring Home. When Spriglet is active, Command-comma opens Settings, Command-Shift-H brings Mallow home, Command-Shift-P pauses or resumes, Command-Shift-M shows or hides, and Command-W closes the focused window.
